messages:
claire-peopleops: Quick q  Samira (EMEA remote) accepted but manager requested parity uplift from band5 -> band6 to match internal peers. Start date 2026-10-05 but immigration docs push payroll enrollment to 2026-10-19. Can we approve uplift and make benefits effective on 10/05?

omar-hiring: Candidate verbally accepted; counteroffer risk is real. Manager wants band6 and day-one benefits to avoid losing them. Will sign once we confirm.

jess-finance: Short flag: uplift cost delta ~\u20AC6,400 annualized. Retro benefits/pension backfill doable but needs CFO sign-off and a payroll note. One-time tax adjustments minimal.

nadia-legal: Legal OK with retroactive enrollment if the signed offer lists start date 10/05 and we keep an exception memo. Recommend capping retro at 14 days and documenting cross-border payroll items.

mike-talent: Talent recommends vendor interim health if payroll misses day-one. Candidate prefers not to wait. We can provision vendor cover for up to 2 weeks.

claire-peopleops: Proposed: provisional band6 pending CFO; approve benefits retroactive to 10/05 up to 14 days; People Ops to provision vendor health if payroll delayed >7 days. Approve?

jess-finance: Conditional OK. I'll ping Maria and prepare short cost note.

hr-bot: Tasks created: "prep-cost-note" -> @jess-finance (due 2026-09-30); "issue-updated-offer" -> @claire-peopleops (due 2026-10-02); "vendor-health-standby" -> @mike-talent (due 2026-10-05).

maria-cfo: (via thread) Reviewed. Approve band6 uplift and benefits retro up to 14 days. Finance to absorb small payroll adj.

jess-finance: CFO approved. Posting numbers and payroll code: EU-EXC-1026.

claire-peopleops: Sending updated offer with effective date 2026-10-05 and exception note. Candidate signed at 11:08. Creating exception record EXC-2026-777 and routing to HR records.

hr-bot: Tasks completed: "prep-cost-note" by @jess-finance (timestamp 2471234595); "issue-updated-offer" by @claire-peopleops (timestamp 2471234602); "vendor-health-standby" by @mike-talent (timestamp 2471234610).

claire-peopleops: Closing thread  everything routed to payroll/records. :white_check_mark:
